notes.title: Full launch, bug fixes and price reduction!
notes.content:
Hey all! So we've been hard at work fixing bugs and adding the most recent round of polish to the game. We've decided to dramatically reduce the price and hope a lot more people can now have the chance to play Freepoint High!

Some of the bigger bugs are gone now, (no more invisible Walker bot tails, no more getting snagged on stairs) and we've introduced and tweaked a few of the Easter Eggs scattered throughout the game.

We really hope you all enjoy the game, we'd love to hear your feedback on how we can improve it in the future!

notes.title: Full game going live Friday! :-D (4/8/16)
notes.content:
Hey guys and gals! We've been burnin' the midnight oil and working our fingers to the bone to get all the things ready for tomorrow's release! We're excited to show off the end-game content, the last level, enemies, and of course, the end-game Boss!

Thank you all so much for your feedback about how we can make our game more enjoyable to play, we've had some really great responses and have tried to implement any of the input that we reasonably could. That said, we still have BIG PLANS for future updates, so stay tuned and follow us on Twitter and Facebook to get all the details!

notes.title: Penultimate Update!
notes.content:
Hi guys and gals! We just pushed out our second to last new content update for the game! You can now rescue every kidnapped kid and collect their powers! Stay tuned, we will be pushing out the last big content update soon, with all the End Game stuff, find out who was behind the attack on the school and why, plus a ton of balance, tweaks, and permanent upgrades to Health and Stamina.

The official Release Date for the game will be Monday, April 4th, so until then we have a ton of polish we're working on.

THIS UPDATE:
-Rescue Abed Sahni from a terrifying reptilian Believer who has taken him to the Deep Woods
-Collect the power of Flight!
-Collect permanent upgrades to Health and Stamina* (in the process of implementing these, still need a layer of polish)
-Lots of under-the-hood bug fixes, polish and updates

KNOWN ISSUES:
- We're still adding all the new textbox dialog, 2 of the Believer encounters still need the Intros/Outros
- Last minute bug snuck in, Back button on the menu screens decided to throw a fit. They still work, just look weird

notes.title: Another content Update! 2/21/16
notes.content:
The Believers have kidnapped Connor and took him away to a beach cave, in the hopes that the cave would interfere with Henry’s Mentalism and Bentley’s boosted Personal Navigator! Luckily the underestimated how clever Bentley is, and the kids were able to locate the general area where they took him, but getting to him is not gunna be easy!

--- 

New Content: 
-Beach Cave level
-New Boss fight (Watch out, she hits like a ton o' bricks!
-Rescue Connor Kokesh and collect his Super Speed ability!
-Hopper bots are not stompable! (like the Uni-Wheel Roller bots)
-Most Believers now have working text intros and outros

Bug Fixes: 
-Fixed some camera issues with several levels
-Began getting the game ready for porting to iOS/Android, so expect some VFX to be transitioning
-Fixed a bunch more bugs


Known Issues: 
-Beach Cave (Super Strength) Believer Boss intro (and outro) still needs textbox triggers 
-We are implementing the expanded leveling-up system, so once you reach level 5, you gain another health bubble..... that doesn't fill yet. Will be fixed next update!
-Stamina cost of all abilities will be tweaked and re-balanced, (giving you the chance to use the different abilities much more)

notes.title: Another Update Going Live Tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hey guys and gals! We're excited for you all the check out our next big update! We get to rescue Evie, the Morph Custodian from the Freepoint Library! Fans of the book will recognize the Library as an important place, and we've made sure to add some fun Easter Eggs!

In addition to the new content, we've also been hard at work squashin bugs and polishing up mechanics. You'll notice the Character Controller is much more smooth now, (you can now shoot at any time, including the apex of your jumps, yay!) and ladders are finally behaving themselves (you can double-jump off all of them now, no more stickiness!) 

---

New Content:
-Freepoint Library
-New Boss fight
-Rescue Evie Taylor and collect her Morph power!
-New level enemies
-New game mechanics- (Morph ability and Mentalism now let you get to secret areas!)

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a ton of camera's going off rails bugs
-Ladders now allow double jumps 100% of the time
-Fixed a bunch more behind the scenes bugs and optimizations in preparation for porting the game to Mobile
-Gave Farm boss a lot more health, no more easy boss fights!
-Added a lot more text boxes

Known Issues:
-Most Believer Boss intros (and outros) still needs textbox triggers
-Cameras can still throw fits in rare instances, but should be MUCH less common now!

notes.title: Update is now live!
notes.content:
Hey guess what! The update is now live! 

Go rescue Chad who is being held captive at Mr. Charles' Farm. While you're there, see if you can find some clues as to who is behind the attack on the School! 

This level is the most challenging level of the game so far. In order to unlock the boss fight, you'll need to collect 3 mysterious artifacts that the Believers seem to find extremely important for their plans! 

---

New Content:
-Mr. Charles' Farm level
-New Boss fight
-Rescue Chad Burke and collect his Invisibility power!
-New level enemies
-New game mechanics

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a camera bug that happened if you died on the Electricity Thrower Believer boss fight
-Ladders easier to navigate and feel better overall
-Fixed some audio bugs where no sound effect played
-Fixed a bunch more behind the scenes bugs

Known Issues:
-Morph Believer Boss intro still needs textbox trigger
-Still need to add textbox triggers for Electricity Thrower and Flight bosses
-Cameras can still fall of the rails here and there, but should be MUCH less common now!

notes.title: Update 1/7/16
notes.content: Hope everybody had a fun Holiday break! We're getting close to releasing another level, boss fight, and super power to collect! Fans of the book will recognize the environment right away, it appears the Believers are looking for something. So while you need to rescue Chad, you'll also need to see if you can find some clues as to what the Believers are up to!
